list.title: Batches
list.intro: Create batches for each course, place approved students and schedule training.
list.caption: Batches
list.empty: No batches match. Add one to get started.

detail.activateBody: Training starts: every student in the batch becomes active and is notified. You need at least one trainer.
detail.closeBody: Closing ends the batch for good: no more attendance, marks, sessions or students. Everything recorded stays readable.
detail.closeNotEnded: The batch can be closed after its end date, {{date}}.
detail.closeUndecided_one: {{count}} student still needs a completion decision:
detail.closeUndecided_other: {{count}} students still need a completion decision:

students.caption: Students in this batch
students.name: Name
students.candidates: Approved and waitlisted applicants for this course
students.noCandidates: No approved or waitlisted applicants chose this course.
students.withdrawBodyPlanned: The seat is freed and the application becomes Withdrawn. The student is notified.
students.withdrawBodyActive: The student stays on this list as Withdrawn, with attendance and marks so far kept, but leaves attendance sheets, mark entry and risk checks. The seat is freed and the student is notified.
students.withdrawReasonRequired: Give a reason of at least 3 characters.

sessions.caption: Sessions
sessions.venueOptional: Venue (optional, defaults to the batch venue)
sessions.timeZoneNote: Times are in India Standard Time (IST).
sessions.freeSlots: Free times nearby (choose one to use it):

allocation.title: Run allocation
allocation.intro: Place every approved applicant into a batch. First choices are filled before second choices; within a choice, the priority rule decides. No batch goes over capacity, and anyone left over is waitlisted.
allocation.confirmBody: {{allocated}} students will be placed and {{waitlisted}} waitlisted. Everyone is notified. This cannot be undone in bulk.
allocation.nothingChanges: This is a preview: nothing has changed yet.

warnings.NO_APPLICANTS: There are no approved applicants to place in this cycle.
warnings.WAITLIST: {{count}} applicant(s) will be waitlisted because their chosen courses are full.
warnings.NO_BATCH_FOR_COURSE: {{count}} chosen course(s) have no batch in this cycle yet.
